subject: ELECTROMAPS | raw rank169 (aliases raw174 Electromaps, raw179 electromaps)

directEvidence.finding: Electromaps confirms it operates managed charging points in France as a CPO in addition to its eMSP role.
Electromaps states charging prices are set by the station owner/CPO and may combine kWh, time and fixed fees; exact connected-station price is shown in the app.
Electromaps Manager lets charging-site owners define the tariff charged to drivers, confirming host/site-configurable pricing.

rejectedEvidence: Electromaps app/eMSP prices and community information are not promoted as CPO-direct authority because Electromaps itself states eMSP pricing can differ from the operator price.
decision: raw169 active->setAside; raw174/raw179 remain non-counting aliases; no anonymous deterministic exact managed-EVSE -> current owner-configured direct tariff feed recovered
fallback: Electra then Electroverse only as roaming fallback where compatible
